title: Dimension is unchanged under base change along field extensions
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $A$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] and $K/k$ a field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then the Krull dimensions [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] of the rings $A\otimes_kK$ and $A$ agree: $\dim(A\otimes_kK)=\dim A$. Hence for a curve $X$ over $k$ [def-pc-curve], the base change [def-pc-base-change] $X_K=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec} k}\operatorname{Spec} K$ has dimension $1$ [def-pc-dimension].
